_comment: Fill in real credentials here. NEVER commit real tokens; add config.json to .gitignore for this workflow.

typeform._help: Typeform → Account settings → Personal tokens. Scope: responses:read only.

surveymonkey._help: SurveyMonkey Developer Portal → Create an app → OAuth. Scopes: surveys_read, responses_read_detail only.

amplitude._help: Amplitude → Settings → Projects → [project] → General. The Export API is read-only by nature.

mixpanel._help: Mixpanel → Project Settings → Service Accounts. Create a service account scoped to this project only.
